title: Residential Electricity Supply Contract Expiration Timetable
content:
Compliance timetable for Residential Electricity Supply. This timetable fixes, for each plan, the windows within which the two contract expiration notices are issued, the post-expiry grace period for a renewal election, the plan an expiring fixed agreement converts to when the customer makes no election, and the rate-hold period that follows a late notice.

| Plan | Initial renewal notice: earliest (days before contract end) | Initial renewal notice: latest (days before contract end) | Final options notice: latest (days before contract end) | Post-expiry renewal grace (calendar days) | Rollover plan | Rate-hold cycles after a late notice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Monthly Variable | 60 | 45 | 30 | 30 | Beacon Ridge Monthly Variable | 2 |
| Beacon Ridge Price Lock 6 | 60 | 45 | 30 | 30 | Beacon Ridge Monthly Variable | 2 |
| Beacon Ridge Price Lock 12 | 60 | 45 | 30 | 30 | Beacon Ridge Monthly Variable | 2 |
| Beacon Ridge Price Lock 24 | 60 | 45 | 30 | 30 | Beacon Ridge Monthly Variable | 2 |
| Beacon Ridge Free Nights 12 | 60 | 45 | 30 | 30 | Beacon Ridge Monthly Variable | 2 |
| Beacon Ridge Clean Wind 12 | 60 | 45 | 30 | 30 | Beacon Ridge Monthly Variable | 2 |
| Beacon Ridge Clean Wind 24 | 60 | 45 | 30 | 30 | Beacon Ridge Monthly Variable | 2 |

**Definitions.**

- *Initial renewal notice, earliest and latest*: the earliest point at which, and the latest point by which, the initial renewal notice is issued, each counted in calendar days before the contract end date.
- *Final options notice, latest*: the latest point, in calendar days before the contract end date, by which the final options notice is issued.
- *Post-expiry renewal grace*: the number of calendar days after the contract end date during which a renewal election is still honoured as a renewal.
- *Rollover plan*: the plan, by official name, that an expiring fixed agreement converts to when the customer makes no election. On every plan it is Beacon Ridge Monthly Variable.
- *Rate-hold cycles*: the number of billing cycles after rollover during which the expiring contract rate is held when the renewal notices were not issued on time.
